item.title: [英语] IELTS5 Reading Passage 2 - 2026-08-31 03:50
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：54 分钟 (2675 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
The psychiatrists felt that 'most subjects would not go beyond 150 volts' and they further anticipated that only four per cent would go up to 300 volts.精神科医生们认为“大多数受试者不会超过150伏”，而且他们进一步预计只有百分之四的人会达到300伏。psychiatrists：精神科医生
subjects：受试者
anticipated：预期
go beyond：超过
volts：伏特		felt that 和 anticipated that 均引导宾语从句；would 表过去将来或推测；further 在此为副词“进一步”。
Furthermore, they thought that only a lunatic fringe of about one in 1,000 would give the highest shock of 450 volts.此外，他们认为只有大约千分之一的极端少数群体才会给出450伏的最高电击。lunatic fringe：极端少数群体
shock：电击
highest：最高的		thought that 引导宾语从句；lunatic fringe 为固定短语，指“疯狂/极端的边缘群体”；one in 1,000 表示“千分之一”。
What were the actual results?实际结果是什么呢？actual：实际的
results：结果（复数）		特殊疑问句，What 作表语；were 与复数 results 保持一致。
Well, over 60 per cent of the teacher-subjects continued to obey Milgram up to the 450-volt limit!嗯，超过60%的教师受试者继续服从Milgram，一直到450伏的极限！teacher-subjects：教师受试者
obey：服从
up to：达到
limit：极限		over + 数字表示“超过”；continue to do sth. 表示“继续做某事”；up to 此处表上限。
In repetitions of the experiment in other countries, the percentage of obedient teacher-subjects was even higher, reaching 85 per cent in one country.在其他国家重复进行该实验时，服从的教师受试者比例甚至更高，在一个国家达到了85%。repetitions：重复
percentage：百分比
obedient：服从的		In repetitions of... 介词短语作状语；reaching 85 per cent 为现在分词短语作伴随/结果状语；even 修饰比较级 higher。
How can we possibly account for this vast discrepancy between what calm, rational, knowledgeable people predict in the comfort of their study and what pressured, flustered, but cooperative 'teachers' actually do in the laboratory of real life?我们怎么可能解释这种巨大的差异呢——一边是冷静、理性、有见识的人在书房的舒适环境中所做的预测，另一边是受压力、慌乱但配合的“教师”在现实生活的实验室里实际所做的事？account for：解释
vast discrepancy：巨大差异
rational：理性的
knowledgeable：有见识的
flustered：慌乱的
cooperative：合作的
laboratory：实验室		How can we possibly account for...? 中 account for 为固定搭配，表示“解释”；between what... and what... 为两个名词性从句并列作 between 的宾语；calm, rational, knowledgeable 与 pressured, flustered, but cooperative 形成对比。
One's first inclination might be to argue that there must be some sort of built-in animal aggression instinct that was activated by the experiment, and that Milgram's teacher-subjects were just following a genetic need to discharge this pent-up primal urge onto the pupil by administering the electrical shock.人们的第一反应可能会争辩说，必定有某种内置的动物攻击本能被实验激活了，而Milgram的教师受试者只是在遵循一种基因需要，即通过施加电击把这种被压抑的原始冲动释放到学生身上。inclination：倾向
built-in：内置的
aggression：攻击性
instinct：本能
activated：被激活
genetic need：基因需要
discharge：释放
pent-up：被压抑的
primal urge：原始冲动
administering：施加		might be to argue that... 中不定式作表语；that 从句作 argue 的宾语；that was activated... 为定语从句修饰 instinct；to discharge... 不定式作 need 的后置定语；onto 与 discharge 搭配。
A modern hard-core sociobiologist might even go so far as to claim that this aggressive instinct evolved as an advantageous trait, having been of survival value to our ancestors in their struggle against the hardships of life on the plains and in the caves, ultimately finding its way into our genetic make-up as a remnant of our ancient animal ways.现代强硬的社会生物学家甚至可能声称，这种攻击本能是作为一种有利特征进化而来的，它对我们祖先在平原和洞穴中与艰难生活作斗争具有生存价值，最终作为我们远古动物行为的残余进入了我们的基因构成。hard-core：强硬的
sociobiologist：社会生物学家
advantageous trait：有利特征
survival value：生存价值
ancestors：祖先
hardships：艰难
plains：平原
caves：洞穴
genetic make-up：基因构成
remnant：残余		go so far as to claim that... 表示“甚至声称……”；having been of survival value... 为现在分词完成式短语作状语，解释 advantageous trait；be of value 为固定搭配；finding its way into... 为现在分词短语作结果状语。
An alternative to this notion of genetic programming is to see the teacher-subjects' actions as a result of the social environment under which the experiment was carried out.与这种基因编程观念不同的另一种解释是，将教师受试者的行为看作实验进行时所处社会环境的结果。alternative：替代方案
notion：观念
genetic programming：基因编程
carried out：实施		an alternative to... 表示“……的替代方案”；is to see... 不定式作表语；under which 引导定语从句，修饰 environment；carry out 为固定搭配，此处用被动语态。
As Milgram himself pointed out, 'Most subjects in the experiment see their behaviour in a larger context that is benevolent and useful to society - the pursuit of scientific truth.正如Milgram本人所指出的那样：“实验中的大多数受试者将自己的行为置于一个更宏大的、仁慈且对社会有益的背景下——即追求科学真理。pointed out：指出
context：背景
benevolent：仁慈的
pursuit：追求		As Milgram himself pointed out 为方式/定语从句，as 指代后面引述内容；that is benevolent... 为定语从句修饰 context；破折号后 the pursuit of scientific truth 作同位语解释 larger context。
The psychological laboratory has a strong claim to legitimacy and evokes trust and confidence in those who perform there.心理学实验室具有强烈的合法性主张，并能在其中工作的人心中唤起信任和信心。psychological：心理学的
claim：主张
legitimacy：合法性
evokes：唤起
perform：工作；执行		have a strong claim to... 表示“对……有强烈主张/权利”；evoke sth. in sb. 表示“在某人心中唤起……”；who 引导定语从句修饰 those。
An action such as shocking a victim, which in isolation appears evil, acquires a completely different meaning when placed in this setting.'像电击受害者这样的行为，孤立地看是邪恶的，但放在这种情境中时就获得了完全不同的意义。”in isolation：孤立地
victim：受害者
evil：邪恶的
acquires：获得
setting：情境		such as 表示举例；which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 an action；when placed in this setting 为“连词+过去分词”的省略时间状语从句，完整为 when it is placed...。
Thus, in this explanation the subject merges his unique personality and personal and moral code with that of larger institutional structures, surrendering individual properties like loyalty, self-sacrifice and discipline to the service of malevolent systems of authority.因此，在这种解释中，受试者将他独特的个性以及个人和道德准则与更大的制度结构相融合，把忠诚、自我牺牲和纪律等个人品质交出来，服务于恶性的权威体系。merges：融合
moral code：道德准则
institutional structures：制度结构
surrendering：交出；放弃
loyalty：忠诚
self-sacrifice：自我牺牲
discipline：纪律
malevolent：恶性的；恶毒的		merge...with... 表示“将……与……融合”；that 指代 personality and personal and moral code，避免重复；surrendering... to... 为现在分词作伴随状语；like 表示举例。
Here we have two radically different explanations for why so many teacher-subjects were willing to forgo their sense of personal responsibility for the sake of an institutional authority figure.这里我们有两种截然不同的解释，说明为什么这么多教师受试者愿意为了机构权威人物而放弃他们的个人责任感。radically：截然地
forgo：放弃
personal responsibility：个人责任感
for the sake of：为了
institutional authority figure：机构权威人物		for why... 中 why 引导宾语从句，作介词 for 的宾语；be willing to do 表示“愿意做”；for the sake of 为固定短语。
The problem for biologists, psychologists and anthropologists is to sort out which of these two polar explanations is more plausible.生物学家、心理学家和人类学家面临的问题是，要弄清这两种极端解释中哪一种更合理。biologists：生物学家
psychologists：心理学家
anthropologists：人类学家
sort out：弄清
polar：极端的
plausible：合理的		The problem for... is to sort out... 不定式作表语；which of these two polar explanations is more plausible 为宾语从句，作 sort out 的宾语，which 表示“哪一个”。

item.title: [英语] IELTS5 Reading Passage 1 等多主题 - 2026-08-24 01:14
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：60 分钟 (2961 字符)

原文 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
From then on, he was to become the Johnson of folklore. 从那时起，他注定要成为民间传说中的约翰逊式人物。 From then on：从那时起
was to become：注定要成为
folklore：民间传说
Johnson：约翰逊（此处代指民间传说式人物）		 was to become 表示注定会/后来会，用于叙述过去将要发生的事；the Johnson of folklore 表示成为某种传说式的人物。
A few years ago, in one of the most fascinating and disturbing experiments in behavioural psychology, Stanley Milgram of Yale University tested 40 subjects from all walks of life for their willingness to obey instructions given by a 'leader' in a situation in which the subjects might feel a personal distaste for the actions they were called upon to perform. 几年前，在行为心理学领域最引人入胜也最令人不安的一项实验中，耶鲁大学的斯坦利·米尔格拉姆测试了来自各行各业的40名被试者，测试他们在可能会对所要求执行的行为感到个人反感的情境中，是否愿意服从“领导者”给出的指令。 fascinating：引人入胜的
disturbing：令人不安的
behavioural psychology：行为心理学
subjects：被试者，实验对象
all walks of life：各行各业，各阶层
willingness：意愿
obey：服从
instructions：指令，指示
leader：领导者
situation：情境
personal distaste：个人反感
called upon to perform：被要求执行		 tested 40 subjects for their willingness to obey 中 for 表示测试的方面；given by a 'leader' 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 instructions；in a situation in which... 为定语从句；called upon to perform 表示被要求执行。
Specifically, Milgram told each volunteer 'teacher-subject' that the experiment was in the noble cause of education, and was designed to test whether or not punishing pupils for their mistakes would have a positive effect on the pupils' ability to learn. 具体来说，米尔格拉姆告诉每一位“教师被试”志愿者，这项实验是为了崇高的教育事业，旨在测试惩罚犯错的学生是否会对学生的学习能力产生积极影响。 Specifically：具体来说
volunteer：志愿者
teacher-subject：教师被试
noble cause：崇高的事业
education：教育
designed to：旨在，被设计用于
punishing：惩罚
pupils：学生
mistakes：错误
positive effect：积极影响
ability to learn：学习能力		 told each volunteer that... 为宾语从句；in the noble cause of education 表示为崇高教育事业；was designed to test whether or not... 为被动语态加 whether 引导的宾语从句；punishing pupils for their mistakes 为动名词短语作主语。
Milgram's experimental set-up involved placing the teacher-subject before a panel of thirty switches with labels ranging from '15 volts of electricity (slight shock)' to '450 volts (danger - severe shock)' in steps of 15 volts each. 米尔格拉姆的实验设置包括让教师被试坐在有30个开关的面板前，标签范围从“15伏电（轻微电击）”到“450伏（危险—严重电击）”，每隔15伏一级。 experimental set-up：实验设置，实验装置
involved：涉及，包含
panel：面板
switches：开关
labels：标签
ranging from...to...：范围从……到……
volts：伏特
electricity：电
slight shock：轻微电击
severe shock：严重电击
in steps of：按……的间隔		 involved placing... 中 involve 后接动名词；with labels ranging from...to... 为现在分词短语作定语；in steps of 15 volts each 表示按每15伏递增。
The teacher-subject was told that whenever the pupil gave the wrong answer to a question, a shock was to be administered, beginning at the lowest level and increasing in severity with each successive wrong answer. 教师被试被告知，每当学生答错问题时，就要施加一次电击，从最低级别开始，并随着每一次连续答错而增强强度。 whenever：每当
gave the wrong answer：答错
administered：施加，执行
beginning at：从……开始
lowest level：最低级别
increasing in severity：强度增加
successive：连续的
wrong answer：错误答案		 was told that... 为被动语态加宾语从句；whenever... 引导时间状语从句；was to be administered 表示按规定将要施加；beginning at... and increasing... 为现在分词短语作方式/伴随状语。
The supposed 'pupil' was in reality an actor hired by Milgram to simulate receiving the shocks by emitting a spectrum of groans, screams and writhings together with an assortment of statements and expletives denouncing both the experiment and the experimenter. 所谓的“学生”实际上是米尔格拉姆雇来的一名演员，通过发出一系列呻吟、尖叫和扭动，以及各种谴责实验和实验者的言辞和脏话来模拟受到电击。 supposed：所谓的
in reality：实际上
actor：演员
hired by：被……雇用
simulate：模拟
receiving the shocks：接受电击
emitting：发出
spectrum：一系列，各种
groans：呻吟
screams：尖叫
writhings：扭动，翻滚
assortment：各种各样
statements：言辞，陈述
expletives：脏话，咒骂
denouncing：谴责
experimenter：实验者		 The supposed 'pupil' 表示所谓的“学生”；was in reality... 表示实际上；hired by Milgram to simulate... 为过去分词短语作后置定语；by emitting... 为方式状语；denouncing both... 为现在分词短语修饰 statements and expletives。
Milgram told the teacher-subject to ignore the reactions of the pupil, and to administer whatever level of shock was called for, as per the rule governing the experimental situation of the moment. 米尔格拉姆告诉教师被试忽略学生的反应，并按照当时实验情境的规则施加所要求级别的电击。 ignore：忽略
reactions：反应
administer：施加
whatever level：无论什么级别
called for：需要，要求
as per：按照
governing：规定，约束
experimental situation：实验情境
of the moment：当时的，当下的		 told sb to ignore... and to administer... 中不定式作宾语补足语；whatever level of shock was called for 为名词性从句作 administer 的宾语；as per 为书面用语，表示按照；governing... 为现在分词作定语修饰 rule。
As the experiment unfolded, the pupil would deliberately give the wrong answers to questions posed by the teacher, thereby bringing on various electrical punishments, even up to the danger level of 300 volts and beyond. 随着实验的进行，学生会故意答错教师提出的问题，从而招致各种电击惩罚，甚至达到300伏及以上的危险级别。 unfolded：展开，进行
deliberately：故意地
posed by：由……提出
thereby：因此，从而
bringing on：招致，引起
electrical punishments：电击惩罚
danger level：危险级别
beyond：超过		 As the experiment unfolded 为时间状语从句；would deliberately give 表示惯常行为/过去将来；posed by the teacher 为过去分词短语作定语；thereby bringing on... 为现在分词短语作结果状语；even up to... and beyond 表示甚至达到并超过该级别。
Many of the teacher-subjects balked at administering the higher levels of punishment, and turned to Milgram with questioning looks and/or complaints about continuing the experiment. 许多教师被试在施加更高级别惩罚时犹豫不决，转向米尔格拉姆，面露疑惑和/或对继续实验提出抱怨。 balked at：对……畏缩，犹豫
administering：施加
higher levels：更高级别
punishment：惩罚
turned to：转向
questioning looks：疑惑的表情
complaints：抱怨
continuing：继续		 Many of the teacher-subjects 表示许多被试；balked at doing 表示不情愿/犹豫做某事；and turned to... 为并列谓语；with questioning looks and/or complaints 为伴随状语；about continuing 表示关于继续实验。
In these situations, Milgram calmly explained that the teacher-subject was to ignore the pupil's cries for mercy and carry on with the experiment. 在这些情况下，米尔格拉姆平静地解释说，教师被试应当忽略学生的求饶并继续实验。 situations：情况
calmly：平静地
explained that：解释说
was to ignore：应当忽略，被要求忽略
cries for mercy：求饶
carry on with：继续		 In these situations 作状语；calmly explained that... 中副词修饰动词；was to ignore 表示指令/规定；cries for mercy 为固定搭配；carry on with 等同于 continue。
If the subject was still reluctant to proceed, Milgram said that it was important for the sake of the experiment that the procedure be followed through to the end. 如果被试仍然不愿继续，米尔格拉姆说，为了实验起见，程序必须被贯彻到底。 reluctant：不情愿的
proceed：继续进行
for the sake of：为了……起见
procedure：程序，步骤
be followed through：被执行到底
to the end：到最后		 If the subject was still reluctant to proceed 为条件句；reluctant to do 表示不愿做某事；it was important... that the procedure be followed... 中 that 从句使用虚拟语气（be 前省略 should）；for the sake of 为固定短语。
His final argument was, 'You have no other choice. You must go on.' 他最后的理由是：“你别无选择。你必须继续。” final argument：最后的理由，最后的论点
no other choice：别无选择
must go on：必须继续		 His final argument was, '...' 中直接引语作表语；You have no other choice. 表示别无选择；must go on 表示必须继续。
What Milgram was trying to discover was the number of teacher-subjects who would be willing to administer the highest levels of shock, even in the face of strong personal and moral revulsion against the rules and conditions of the experiment. 米尔格拉姆试图发现的是，即使面对个人和道德上对实验规则与条件的强烈反感，仍愿意施加最高级别电击的教师被试人数。 discover：发现
the number of：……的数量
willing to：愿意
highest levels：最高级别
shock：电击
in the face of：面对
strong：强烈的
personal：个人的
moral：道德的
revulsion：强烈反感，厌恶
against：对……，反对
rules and conditions：规则和条件		 What Milgram was trying to discover was... 为主语从句；the number of teacher-subjects who... 中 who 引导定语从句；even in the face of... 为让步状语；revulsion against... 表示对……的反感。
Prior to carrying out the experiment, Milgram explained his idea to a group of 39 psychiatrists and asked them to predict the average percentage of people in an ordinary population who would be willing to administer the highest shock level of 450 volts. 在进行实验之前，米尔格拉姆向由39名精神病学家组成的小组解释了他的想法，并请他们预测普通人群中愿意施加最高450伏电击的人的平均百分比。 Prior to：在……之前
carrying out：进行，实施
psychiatrists：精神病学家
predict：预测
average percentage：平均百分比
ordinary population：普通人群
administer：施加
shock level：电击级别		 Prior to carrying out 中 prior to 后接动名词；explained his idea to... 为双宾语结构；asked them to predict... 中不定式作宾补；people in an ordinary population who... 中 who 引导定语从句。
The overwhelming consensus was that virtually all the teacher-subjects would refuse to obey the experiment. 压倒性的一致意见是，几乎所有教师被试都会拒绝服从这项实验。 overwhelming：压倒性的
consensus：共识，一致意见
virtually：几乎，实际上
all the teacher-subjects：所有教师被试
refuse to obey：拒绝服从
experiment：实验		 The overwhelming consensus was that... 为表语从句；virtually all 表示几乎全部；refuse to obey 表示拒绝服从。注意 obey 通常接人或指令，此处接 experiment 为略有省略的用法。

item.title: [英语] IELTS5 Reading Passage 1 - 2026-08-20 01:41
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：45 分钟 (2235 字符)

原文 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
The work was immense; filling about eighty large notebooks (and without a library to hand), Johnson wrote the definitions of over 40,000 words, and illustrated their many meanings with some 114,000 quotations drawn from English writing on every subject, from the Elizabethans to his own time. 这项工作规模巨大；约翰逊填写了大约八十本大笔记本（而且手边没有图书馆），他写下了四万多个词的定义，并用约十一万四千条引文阐释了它们的许多含义，这些引文来自各个学科的英语作品，从伊丽莎白时代一直到他自己所处的时代。 'immense: 巨大的，广大的'
'definitions: 定义'
'illustrated: 阐释，说明'
'quotations: 引文，引语'
'drawn from: 取自，来自'
'Elizabethans: 伊丽莎白时代的人/作家'		 分号连接两个并列分句；后半句有现在分词短语 filling... 作伴随/补充说明；Johnson wrote... and illustrated... 为并列谓语；drawn from... 是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 quotations；from the Elizabethans to his own time 是介词短语表范围。
He did not expect to achieve complete originality. 他并未指望做到完全原创。 'achieve: 实现，达到'
'complete: 完全的'
'originality: 独创性，原创性'		 did not expect to do sth 固定结构，表示“没指望/没预料到会做某事”；achieve 后接名词，常表示实现目标、成就等。
Working to a deadline, he had to draw on the best of all previous dictionaries, and to make his work one of heroic synthesis. 由于必须在截止日期前完成，他不得不借鉴此前所有词典中的精华，并使自己的作品成为一部英雄般的综合之作。 'deadline: 截止日期'
'draw on: 利用，借鉴'
'previous: 先前的'
'heroic: 英雄般的，宏伟的'
'synthesis: 综合，合成'		 Working to a deadline 是现在分词短语作原因/伴随状语；had to draw on... and to make... 并列不定式作 had to 的宾语，说明不得不做的两件事；one of heroic synthesis 中 of 加名词表示性质、特征。
In fact, it was very much more. 事实上，它的意义远不止于此。 'In fact: 事实上'
'very much more: 多得多，远不止此'		 In fact 作插入语表示强调或转折；more 在此为代词，指代“更大的成就/更多的意义”，very much 修饰比较级 more。
Unlike his predecessors, Johnson treated English very practically, as a living language, with many different shades of meaning. 与前辈们不同，约翰逊非常注重实用地对待英语，把它当作一门活的语言，具有许多不同的意义层次。 'unlike: 与……不同'
'predecessors: 前任，前辈'
'practically: 实际地，注重实用地'
'living language: 活的语言'
'shades: 细微差别，层次'		 Unlike his predecessors 是介词短语作状语，表示对比；treated English very practically 中 practically 为副词修饰动词；as a living language 是介词短语作方式状语，说明如何对待英语；with many different shades of meaning 为伴随状语。
He adopted his definitions on the principle of English common law - according to precedent. 他按照英国普通法的原则——遵循先例——来确定词义定义。 'adopted: 采纳，采用'
'definitions: 定义'
'principle: 原则'
'common law: 普通法'
'according to: 根据'
'precedent: 先例'		 adopted... on the principle of... 表示“按照……原则采纳/制定……”；破折号后 according to precedent 是对 principle 的补充说明，相当于同位语；according to 是固定搭配。
After its publication, his Dictionary was not seriously rivalled for over a century. 出版之后，他的词典在一个多世纪里都没有遇到真正有力的竞争对手。 'publication: 出版'
'seriously: 真正地，严重地'
'rivalled: 与……匹敌，竞争'
'over a century: 一个多世纪'		 After its publication 是时间状语；was not seriously rivalled 是被动语态，表示“没有受到严重竞争/挑战”；for over a century 表示持续一段时间。
After many vicissitudes the Dictionary was finally published on 15 April 1775. 历经许多波折之后，这部词典终于在1775年4月15日出版。 'vicissitudes: 变迁，波折，沉浮'
'finally: 终于'
'published: 出版'		 After many vicissitudes 是时间状语；was finally published 为被动语态；日期前用 on，具体某一天用介词 on。
It was instantly recognised as a landmark throughout Europe. 它立即在欧洲各地被公认为一座里程碑。 'instantly: 立即'
'recognised as: 被公认为'
'landmark: 里程碑，标志性成果'
'throughout: 遍及，贯穿'		 was instantly recognised as 是被动语态，固定搭配 recognise...as... 表示“把……认作/公认为……”；throughout Europe 表示范围。
'This very noble work,' wrote the leading Italian lexicographer, 'will be a perpetual monument of Fame to the Author, an Honour to his own Country in particular, and a general Benefit to the republic of Letters throughout Europe.' “这部非常崇高的作品，”意大利著名词典编纂者写道，“将成为作者永恒的声誉丰碑，尤其为他自己的国家带来荣耀，并为整个欧洲文学界带来普遍福祉。” 'noble: 崇高的，高贵的'
'leading: 领头的，著名的'
'lexicographer: 词典编纂者'
'perpetual: 永恒的'
'monument: 丰碑，纪念碑'
'Fame: 声誉，名望'
'Author: 作者'
'Honour: 荣誉'
'in particular: 尤其'
'general: 普遍的'
'Benefit: 福祉，益处'
'republic of Letters: 文学界，知识界'		 直接引语被插入语 wrote the leading Italian lexicographer 分隔，引语前后用逗号；a perpetual monument of Fame to..., an Honour to..., and a general Benefit to... 为并列名词短语作表语；in particular 插入强调。
The fact that Johnson had taken on the Academies of Europe and matched them (everyone knew that forty French academics had taken forty years to produce the first French national dictionary) was cause for much English celebration. 约翰逊承担起欧洲各学院的任务并与它们相匹敌（众所周知，四十位法国学者花了四十年才编出第一部法语国家词典），这一事实成为英国人广为庆祝的理由。 'fact: 事实'
'taken on: 承担，接受挑战'
'Academies: 学院，学术机构'
'matched: 与……匹敌'
'academics: 学者'
'took forty years: 花了四十年'
'national dictionary: 国家词典'
'cause: 理由，事业'
'celebration: 庆祝'		 The fact that... 是同位语从句，that 从句说明 fact 的内容；括号内为补充说明，everyone knew that... 是宾语从句；taken on 和 matched 是并列谓语；was cause for... 是固定搭配，表示“是……的理由/原因”。
Johnson had worked for nine years, 'with little assistance of the learned, and without any patronage of the great; not in the soft obscurities of retirement, or under the shelter of academic bowers, but amidst inconvenience and distraction, in sickness and in sorrow'. 约翰逊工作了九年，“几乎没有学者的帮助，也没有权贵的赞助；不是在隐居的安逸幽静中，也不是在学术殿堂的庇护下，而是在不便与纷扰中、在疾病与忧伤中”工作。 'assistance: 帮助'
'the learned: 学者'
'patronage: 赞助，庇护'
'the great: 权贵，大人物'
'obscurities: 隐居，默默无闻'
'retirement: 退休，隐居'
'shelter: 庇护，遮蔽'
'academic bowers: 学术殿堂/庇护所'
'amidst: 在……之中'
'inconvenience: 不便'
'distraction: 纷扰，干扰'
'sickness: 疾病'
'sorrow: 忧伤'		 with little assistance... and without any patronage... 是并列介词短语表示伴随的缺乏条件；not... or... but... 结构表示否定与肯定对比；amidst inconvenience and distraction, in sickness and in sorrow 为并列状语，强调艰难环境。
For all its faults and eccentricities his two-volume work is a masterpiece and a landmark, in his own words, 'setting the orthography, displaying the analogy, regulating the structures, and ascertaining the significations of English words'. 尽管存在种种缺陷和怪异之处，他的两卷本著作仍是一部杰作和里程碑，用他自己的话说，它“确立拼写法，展示类比关系，规范结构，并确定英语词汇的意义”。 'For all: 尽管'
'faults: 缺点'
'eccentricities: 古怪之处'
'two-volume: 两卷本的'
'masterpiece: 杰作'
'landmark: 里程碑'
'in his own words: 用他自己的话说'
'setting: 确立'
'orthography: 拼写法'
'displaying: 展示'
'analogy: 类比'
'regulating: 规范'
'ascertaining: 确定'
'significations: 意义'		 For all... 表示“尽管”，引导让步状语；is a masterpiece and a landmark 是主系表结构；in his own words 是插入语；引号内四个并列的现在分词短语 setting..., displaying..., regulating..., and ascertaining... 作句子的补充说明。
It is the cornerstone of Standard English, an achievement which, in James Boswell's words, 'conferred stability on the language of his country'. 它是标准英语的基石，用詹姆斯·博斯韦尔的话说，这是一项“赋予他祖国语言以稳定性”的成就。 'cornerstone: 基石'
'Standard English: 标准英语'
'achievement: 成就'
'in James Boswell's words: 用……的话说'
'conferred: 赋予'
'stability: 稳定性'		 It is the cornerstone of Standard English 是主系表结构；an achievement which... 是同位语，which 引导定语从句修饰 achievement；in James Boswell's words 是插入语；conferred stability on... 是固定搭配 confer sth on sb/sth。
The Dictionary, together with his other writing, made Johnson famous and so well esteemed that his friends were able to prevail upon King George III to offer him a pension. 这部词典以及他的其他著作使约翰逊声名远扬、备受尊敬，以至于他的朋友们能够说服国王乔治三世给他提供一笔养老金。 'together with: 连同，以及'
'writing: 著作'
'famous: 著名的'
'esteemed: 受尊敬的'
'prevail upon: 说服'
'pension: 养老金，津贴'		 together with his other writing 是插入语，不影响主谓一致，主语是 The Dictionary；made Johnson famous and so well esteemed 是 make + 宾语 + 宾补结构，and 连接两个宾补；so... that... 引导结果状语从句；prevail upon sb to do sth 是固定搭配，表示“说服某人做某事”。

item.title: [英语] IELTS5 Reading Passage 1 - 2026-08-18 01:16
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：49 分钟 (2416 字符)

原文 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
There was no standard way of speaking or writing and no agreement as to the best way of bringing some order to the chaos of English spelling. 没有标准的说或写方式，也没有一致意见：用什么最佳方式给混乱的英语拼写带来一些秩序。 standard：标准的
agreement：一致意见
as to：关于
bring order to：给……带来秩序
chaos：混乱
spelling：拼写		 There was no... and no... 为并列否定结构；as to 后接名词或疑问词引导的从句，表示“关于”。
Dr Johnson provided the solution. 约翰逊博士提供了解决办法。 solution：解决办法 provide the solution 表示“提供解决办法”；solution 常与 to 搭配，如 the solution to the problem。
There had, of course, been dictionaries in the past, the first of these being a little book of some 120 pages, compiled by a certain Robert Cawdray, published in 1604 under the title 'A Table Alphabeticall of hard usuall English wordes'. 当然，过去曾有过一些词典，其中第一本是一本约120页的小书，由一位叫罗伯特·考德雷的人编纂，1604年以《难用的常用英语词汇字母表》为名出版。 of course：当然
compile：编纂
publish：出版
under the title：以……为标题
a certain：某个
some：大约
alphabeticall：字母顺序的（古拼写）
usuall：常用的（古拼写）
wordes：词汇（古拼写）		 the first of these being... 为独立主格结构，表示补充说明；compiled... / published... 为过去分词短语作后置定语。
Like the various dictionaries that came after it during the seventeenth century, Cawdray's tended to concentrate on 'scholarly' words; one function of the dictionary was to enable its student to convey an impression of fine learning. 与17世纪继它之后出现的各种词典一样，考德雷的词典倾向于集中收录“学术性”词汇；词典的功能之一是让使用者传达出博学的印象。 various：各种各样的
tend to：倾向于
concentrate on：集中于
scholarly：学术的
function：功能
enable sb to do：使某人能够做
convey：传达
impression：印象
fine learning：博学		 Like... 为介词短语作比较状语；that came after it 为定语从句修饰 dictionaries；one function of... was to enable... 中不定式作表语。
Beyond the practical need to make order out of chaos, the rise of dictionaries is associated with the rise of the English middle class, who were anxious to define and circumscribe the various worlds to conquer - lexical as well as social and commercial. 除了让混乱变得有序这一实际需要之外，词典的兴起也与英国中产阶级的兴起有关；他们急于界定并限制各个即将征服的领域——词汇领域以及社会和商业领域。 beyond：除……之外
practical：实际的
make order out of chaos：从混乱中建立秩序
be associated with：与……有关
middle class：中产阶级
anxious：急于的
define：界定
circumscribe：限制、划定
conquer：征服
lexical：词汇的
commercial：商业的		 Beyond... 作状语，表示“除……之外”；who were anxious to... 为非限制性定语从句修饰 middle class；as well as 连接并列成分。
It is highly appropriate that Dr Samuel Johnson, the very model of an eighteenth-century literary man, as famous in his own time as in ours, should have published his Dictionary at the very beginning of the heyday of the middle class. 塞缪尔·约翰逊博士是18世纪文人的典范，他在自己的时代和在我们的时代同样有名；他在中产阶级全盛期之初出版词典，这是非常恰当的。 highly：非常
appropriate：恰当的
model：典范
literary：文学的
as famous... as...：和……一样有名
publish：出版
at the very beginning of：在……最初
heyday：全盛时期		 It is highly appropriate that... 为主语从句；should have published 在此表示“竟然/应当”；the very model of... 作 Dr Samuel Johnson 的同位语。
Johnson was a poet and critic who raised common sense to the heights of genius. 约翰逊是一位诗人和评论家，他把常识提升到了天才的高度。 poet：诗人
critic：评论家
common sense：常识
raise... to...：把……提升到……
heights：高度、巅峰
genius：天才		 who raised... 为定语从句修饰 a poet and critic；raise... to the heights of... 是比喻性表达。
His approach to the problems that had worried writers throughout the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries was intensely practical. 他处理那些困扰了17世纪末和18世纪初作家们的问题的方法非常务实。 approach：方法
worry：使担忧
throughout：贯穿
intensely：极度地
practical：务实的		 approach to the problems 中的 to 是介词，后接名词；that had worried... 为定语从句修饰 problems。
Up until his time, the task of producing a dictionary on such a large scale had seemed impossible without the establishment of an academy to make decisions about right and wrong usage. 在他那个时代之前，若不建立一个负责判定用法正误的学院，如此大规模地编写词典的任务似乎是不可能完成的。 up until：直到……之前
task：任务
on such a large scale：如此大规模地
establishment：建立
academy：学院、学会
make decisions about：对……作出决定
usage：用法		 Up until his time 为时间状语；without the establishment of... 为介词短语，表示假设条件；to make decisions 为不定式作后置定语修饰 academy。
Johnson decided he did not need an academy to settle arguments about language; he would write a dictionary himself; and he would do it single-handed. 约翰逊认定他不需要一个学院来解决关于语言的争论；他要自己编写一本词典，并且要独自完成。 decide：决定
settle：解决
argument：争论
single-handed：独自地		 decided 后接省略 that 的宾语从句；did not need... to settle... 中不定式作目的或补充；he would... 表示过去的决心或意图；single-handed 作方式状语。
Johnson signed the contract for the Dictionary with the bookseller Robert Dosley at a breakfast held at the Golden Anchor Inn near Holborn Bar on 18 June 1764. 1764年6月18日，在霍尔本栅栏附近的金锚旅馆举行的一次早餐上，约翰逊与书商罗伯特·多斯利签订了这部词典的合同。 sign：签署
contract：合同
bookseller：书商
inn：小旅馆
bar：栅栏（此处为地名）
held：举行		 signed the contract with sb 表示“与某人签合同”；at a breakfast held at... 中 held 为过去分词作后置定语修饰 breakfast。
He was to be paid £1,575 in instalments, and from this he took money to rent 17 Gough Square, in which he set up his 'dictionary workshop'. 他将以分期付款的方式获得1575英镑，并从中拿出钱租下高夫广场17号，在那里建立了他的“词典工作坊”。 be to do：计划/注定要做
instalments：分期付款
rent：租用
set up：建立
workshop：工作坊		 was to be paid 为过去将来时被动式；in instalments 表示“以分期付款方式”；in which he set up... 为非限制性定语从句修饰 17 Gough Square。
James Boswell, his biographer, described the garret where Johnson worked as 'fitted up like a counting house' with a long desk running down the middle at which the copying clerks would work standing up. 他的传记作者詹姆斯·博斯韦尔描述约翰逊工作的阁楼“布置得像一间账房”，中间放着一张长桌，抄写员们会站在桌边工作。 biographer：传记作者
describe... as...：把……描述为……
garret：阁楼
fitted up：布置
counting house：账房
running down the middle：沿中间延伸
clerk：文书、职员
standing up：站着		 his biographer 为 James Boswell 的同位语；where Johnson worked 为定语从句修饰 garret；with a long desk running... 为 with 复合结构；at which... 为定语从句修饰 desk。
Johnson himself was stationed on a rickety chair at an old crazy deal table surrounded by a chaos of borrowed books. 约翰逊本人坐在一张摇摇晃晃的椅子上，面对一张破旧的松木桌，四周堆满了借来的书。 station：安置、使就座
rickety：摇摇晃晃的
crazy：破旧的、歪斜的
deal table：松木桌
surrounded by：被……包围
chaos：混乱
borrowed：借来的		 was stationed 为被动语态，表示“被安置在”；surrounded by... 为过去分词短语作后置定语；a chaos of 表示“大量杂乱的”。
He was also helped by six assistants, two of whom died whilst the Dictionary was still in preparation. 他还得到六名助手的帮助，其中两人在词典仍在编纂期间去世。 assistant：助手
whilst：当……时候
in preparation：在准备中		 was helped by 为被动语态；two of whom died 为非限制性定语从句，whom 指代 six assistants；whilst 相当于 while。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 3 等多主题 - 2026-08-17 01:19
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：33 分钟 (1607 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
We have found that the blind understand other kinds of visual metaphors as well. 我们发现盲人也能理解其他类型的视觉隐喻。 visual metaphors：视觉隐喻
as well：也		 that引导宾语从句；as well 放句末表示“也”。
One blind woman drew a picture of a child inside a heart - choosing that symbol, she said, to show that love surrounded the child. 一位失明女性画了一幅孩子在心形里面的画——她选择那个符号，她说，是为了表明爱包围着这个孩子。 drew a picture：画了一幅画
symbol：符号
surrounded：包围		 破折号后为现在分词短语作伴随状语；she said是插入语；to show...为目的状语。
With Chang Hong Liu, a doctoral student from China, I have begun exploring how well blind people understand the symbolism behind shapes such as hearts that do not directly represent their meaning. 和来自中国的博士生 Chang Hong Liu 一起，我已经开始探索盲人在多大程度上理解像心形这样并不直接代表其含义的形状背后的象征意义。 doctoral student：博士生
exploring：探索
symbolism：象征意义
represent：代表		 With...介词短语作状语；a doctoral student from China是同位语；how well引导宾语从句；such as hearts that...中that引导定语从句修饰hearts。
We gave a list of twenty pairs of words to sighted subjects and asked them to pick from each pair the term that best related to a circle and the term that best related to a square. 我们给视力正常的受试者一份二十对词的列表，并要求他们从每一对中选出与圆形最相关的词和与方形最相关的词。 sighted subjects：视力正常的受试者
term：词语；术语
related to：与……相关		 gave和asked并列作谓语；asked them to pick...为不定式宾补；that best related...为定语从句修饰term。
For example, we asked: What goes with soft? A circle or a square? Which shape goes with hard? 例如，我们问：什么与柔软相配？圆形还是方形？哪个形状与坚硬相配？ goes with：与……相配
soft：柔软的
hard：坚硬的		 直接引语；What goes with soft? 疑问句结构：What + goes with + 名词。
All our subjects deemed the circle soft and the square hard. 我们所有的受试者都认为圆形柔软、方形坚硬。 deemed：认为
soft：柔软的
hard：坚硬的		 deem + 宾语 + 形容词，表示“认为……”。
A full 94% ascribed happy to the circle, instead of sad. 整整94%的人把快乐归于圆形，而不是悲伤。 ascribed：把……归于
instead of：而不是		 ascribe A to B 把A归于B；instead of 后接形容词/名词。
But other pairs revealed less agreement: 79% matched fast to slow and weak to strong, respectively. 但其他配对显示出较少的共识：79%的人分别将快与慢、弱与强进行匹配。 revealed：显示出
agreement：一致
respectively：分别地		 冒号引出具体数据；respectively 分别地，注意对应顺序。
And only 51% linked deep to circle and shallow to square. (See Fig. 2) 只有51%的人把深与圆形、浅与方形联系起来。（见图2） linked：联系
shallow：浅的		 link A to B 把A和B联系起来；See Fig. 2 为插入语。
When we tested four totally blind volunteers using the same list, we found that their choices closely resembled those made by the sighted subjects. 当我们用同样的列表测试四名完全失明的志愿者时，我们发现他们的选择与视力正常的受试者做出的选择非常相似。 totally：完全地
volunteers：志愿者
closely resembled：非常相似		 When引导时间状语从句；that引导宾语从句；those made by...过去分词短语作后置定语，意思是“由……做出的选择”。
One man, who had been blind since birth, scored extremely well. 一名从出生起就失明的男子表现得极好。 blind since birth：先天失明
scored extremely well：表现得极好		 who引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明；since birth 从出生起。
He made only one match differing from the consensus, assigning 'far' to square and 'near' to circle. 他只有一处匹配与共识不同，把“far”对应到方形，把“near”对应到圆形。 consensus：共识
assigning：分配；归因
differing from：与……不同		 differing from...现在分词短语作定语；assigning...现在分词短语作伴随状语。
In fact, only a small majority of sighted subjects - 53% - had paired far and near to the opposite partners. 事实上，只有微弱多数的视力正常受试者——53%——将 far 和 near 与共识中相反的伙伴配对。 majority：多数
opposite partners：相反的配对		 破折号插入53%；only a small majority 微弱多数；pair A to B 把A与B配对。
Thus, we concluded that the blind interpret abstract shapes as sighted people do. 因此，我们得出结论：盲人和视力正常的人一样理解抽象形状。 concluded：得出结论
interpret：理解
abstract shapes：抽象形状		 conclude that... 得出结论；as sighted people do 为方式状语从句，do替代interpret。
For the century before Johnson's Dictionary was published in 1775, there had been concern about the state of the English language. 在1775年《约翰逊词典》出版之前的那个世纪里，人们一直对英语语言的状况感到担忧。 concern：担忧
state：状况
published：出版		 For the century before...时间状语；before Johnson's Dictionary was published为时间状语从句；there had been concern 过去完成时表示持续到过去某时的担忧。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 3 - 2026-08-14 02:01
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：39 分钟 (1912 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
Majority rule would argue that this device somehow indicated motion very well.多数原则会认为这个装置以某种方式很好地指示了运动。majority rule：多数原则
device：装置，设备
indicate：指示，表明
motion：运动		would argue 表示“会主张/认为”，是常见的拟人表达；somehow 表示“以某种方式，不知怎么地”。
But was it a better indicator than, say, broken or wavy lines – or any other kind of line, for that matter?但它就是比，比如说，断裂的线或波浪线——或任何其他种类的线——更好的指示物吗？indicator：指示物，指标
wavy：波浪形的
broken line：断裂的线，虚线
for that matter：就此而言，而且		than, say, ... 中的 say 是插入语，表示举例“比如说”；for that matter 用于补充说明“就此而言”。
The answer was not clear.答案并不明确。clear：清楚的，明确的
not clear：不清楚		not clear 是常见的形容词作表语的否定表达。
So I decided to test whether various lines of motion were apt ways of showing movement or if they were merely idiosyncratic marks.因此我决定测试各种运动线条是否是表示运动的合适方式，或者它们是否仅仅是特殊的记号。apt：合适的，恰当的
merely：仅仅，只不过
idiosyncratic：独特的，怪异的
marks：记号，痕迹		whether ... or if ... 引导并列的宾语从句，表示“是……还是……”；apt ways 中 apt 表示“合适的”。
Moreover, I wanted to discover whether there were differences in how the blind and the sighted interpreted lines of motion.此外，我想发现盲人和视力正常者在理解运动线条方面是否存在差异。Moreover：此外，而且
discover：发现
the blind / the sighted：盲人 / 视力正常者
interpret：解释，理解		the + 形容词表示一类人，如 the blind, the sighted；how 引导的宾语从句作 in 的宾语。
To search out these answers, I created raised-line drawings of five different wheels, depicting spokes with lines that curved, bent, waved, dashed and extended beyond the perimeter of the wheel.为了找出这些答案，我制作了五个不同轮子的凸起线条图，图中用弯曲、折弯、波浪、虚线和延伸到轮子周边之外的线条来描绘辐条。search out：找出，查明
raised-line drawings：凸起线条图
depict：描绘
spokes：辐条
curved：弯曲的
bent：折弯的
dashed：虚线的
perimeter：周界，周长		To search out... 不定式表目的；depicting... 现在分词短语作伴随/后置定语；lines that curved, bent, waved, dashed and extended... 中几个过去式并列作定语从句谓语。
I then asked eighteen blind volunteers to feel the wheels and assign one of the following motions to each wheel: wobbling, spinning fast, spinning steadily, jerking or braking.然后我请十八位盲人志愿者触摸这些轮子，并给每个轮子分配以下动作之一：摆动、快速旋转、匀速旋转、急动或刹车。volunteers：志愿者
assign：分配，指派
wobbling：摇摆，晃动
spinning：旋转
steadily：稳定地，持续地
jerking：急动，颠簸
braking：刹车		ask sb to do sth 结构；assign A to B：将A分配给B；冒号后列举动作，用动名词形式。
My control group consisted of eighteen sighted undergraduates from the University of Toronto.我的对照组由十八名来自多伦多大学的视力正常本科生组成。control group：对照组
consist of：由……组成
undergraduates：本科生		consist of 表示“由……组成”，不用于被动语态；from the University of Toronto 作后置定语。
All but one of the blind subjects assigned distinctive motions to each wheel.除了一名盲人受试者外，所有盲人都给每个轮子分配了不同的动作。All but one：除一个以外的所有
subjects：受试者，实验对象
distinctive：独特的，有区别的		All but one 表示“除一个之外的全部”；assign sth to sb/sth 结构再次出现。
Most guessed that the curved spokes indicated that the wheel was spinning steadily; the wavy spokes, they thought, suggested that the wheel was wobbling; and the bent spokes were taken as a sign that the wheel was jerking.大多数人猜测弯曲的辐条表示轮子在匀速旋转；他们认为波浪形辐条表明轮子在摆动；而折弯的辐条被看作是轮子在急动的标志。guessed：猜测
curved：弯曲的
spinning steadily：匀速旋转
wavy：波浪形的
suggested：暗示，表明
bent：折弯的
taken as a sign：被当作标志		guessed that... 宾语从句；they thought 作插入语；be taken as 表示“被当作/认为”。
Subjects assumed that spokes extending beyond the wheel's perimeter signified that the wheel had its brakes on and that dashed spokes indicated the wheel was spinning quickly.受试者认为，延伸到轮子周边之外的辐条意味着轮子正在刹车，而虚线辐条表明轮子转得很快。assumed：假定，认为
extending beyond：延伸超出
perimeter：周界，周长
signified：表示，意味着
brakes on：刹车（状态）
dashed：虚线的
spinning quickly：快速旋转		extending beyond... 现在分词短语作后置定语；signified that... 宾语从句；had its brakes on 中 on 表示处于开启/使用状态。
In addition, the favored description for the sighted was the favored description for the blind in every instance.此外，在每个实例中，视力正常者偏好的描述也正是盲人偏好的描述。In addition：此外
favored：受青睐的，偏好的
description：描述
in every instance：在每一个事例中		In addition 用于补充；favored description 指“最受偏好的描述”；in every instance 作状语。
What is more, the consensus among the sighted was barely higher than that among the blind.更重要的是，视力正常者之间的共识度仅比盲人之间的共识度略高一点。What is more：更重要的是
consensus：共识，一致意见
barely：仅仅，几乎不
among：在……之中		What is more 是递进连接语；barely higher than 表示“仅略高于”；that 指代前面的 consensus，避免重复。
Because motion devices are unfamiliar to the blind, the task I gave them involved some problem solving.由于运动装置对盲人来说并不熟悉，我交给他们的任务涉及了一些问题解决过程。motion devices：运动装置
unfamiliar：不熟悉的
involved：涉及，需要
problem solving：问题解决		Because 引导原因状语从句；unfamiliar to sb 表示“对某人来说不熟悉”；I gave them 是省略了关系代词 that/which 的定语从句修饰 task。
Evidently, however, the blind not only figured out meanings for each line of motion, but as a group they generally came up with the same meaning at least as frequently as did sighted subjects.然而，很明显，盲人不仅弄清了每种运动线条的含义，而且作为一个群体，他们通常得出相同含义的频率至少与视力正常受试者一样高。Evidently：显然，明显地
figured out：弄明白，理解
as a group：作为一个群体
came up with：提出，想出
at least as frequently as：至少和……一样频繁		not only... but... 连接并列谓语/句子；as frequently as did sighted subjects 是倒装比较状语从句，did 代替 came up with；figure out 和 come up with 为短语动词。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 2 等多主题 - 2026-08-11 01:48
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：42 分钟 (2075 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
Although the senses of taste and smell appear to have deteriorated, and vision in water appears to be uncertain, such weaknesses are more than compensated for by cetaceans' well-developed acoustic sense.尽管味觉和嗅觉似乎已经退化，水中视力也显得不可靠，但这些弱点被鲸类发达的听觉所弥补，而且还绰绰有余。deteriorated：退化
compensated for：弥补，补偿
cetaceans：鲸类动物
acoustic：听觉的		Although 引导让步状语从句；more than compensated for 中 more than 加强程度，表示“远远不只是弥补”。
Most species are highly vocal, although they vary in the range of sounds they produce, and many forage for food using echolocation.大多数物种都很善于发声，尽管它们发出的声音范围各不相同，而且许多物种利用回声定位来觅食。vocal：发声的，有声音的
vary in：在…方面不同
forage for：搜寻（食物）
echolocation：回声定位		although 连接让步状语从句；using echolocation 为现在分词短语作方式状语。
Large baleen whales primarily use the lower frequencies and are often limited in their repertoire.大型须鲸主要使用较低频率，其声音节目通常也很有限。baleen whales：须鲸
primarily：主要地
frequencies：频率
repertoire：全部节目，这里指能发出的全部声音		are limited in their repertoire 表示“在声音种类上有限”。
Notable exceptions are the nearly song-like choruses of bowhead whales in summer and the complex, haunting utterances of the humpback whales.值得注意的例外是夏季弓头鲸近乎歌曲般的合唱，以及座头鲸复杂而令人难忘的叫声。notable：显著的，值得注意的
choruses：合唱
bowhead whales：弓头鲸
haunting：萦绕心头的，令人难忘的
utterances：发声，叫声
humpback whales：座头鲸		notable exceptions 为主语，are 后面跟两个并列的表语，介绍两种例外情况。
Toothed species in general employ more of the frequency spectrum, and produce a wider variety of sounds, than baleen species (though the sperm whale apparently produces a monotonous series of high-energy clicks and little else).齿鲸类总体上比须鲸类使用更宽的频谱，并产生更多样的声音（尽管抹香鲸显然只发出单调的一系列高能咔嗒声，其余几乎没有）。toothed species：齿鲸类
employ：使用，利用
frequency spectrum：频谱
baleen species：须鲸类
sperm whale：抹香鲸
monotonous：单调的
clicks：咔嗒声		比较级 more... than...；括号内 though 引导让步状语从句；a monotonous series of... 表示“一连串单调的…”。
Some of the more complicated sounds are clearly communicative, although what role they may play in the social life and 'culture' of cetaceans has been more the subject of wild speculation than of solid science.一些较复杂的声音明显具有交流功能，尽管它们在鲸类的社会生活和“文化”中可能起什么作用，与其说是可靠的科学，不如说是胡乱的猜测。complicated：复杂的
communicative：交流的，交际的
role：作用，角色
wild speculation：胡乱的猜测
solid science：可靠的科学结论		what role they may play 为主语从句；more A than B 结构表示“与其说是B，不如说是A”。
From a number of recent studies, it has become clear that blind people can appreciate the use of outlines and perspectives to describe the arrangement of objects and other surfaces in space.根据大量近期研究，盲人能够理解用轮廓和透视法来描述物体和其他表面在空间中的排列这一点，已经变得很清楚。appreciate：理解，领会
outlines：轮廓
perspectives：透视法，视角
arrangement：排列，安排
surfaces：表面		it has become clear that... 为形式主语句式；that 从句为主语。
But pictures are more than literal representations.但图画不仅仅是照字面的再现。literal representations：字面再现，写实表现
more than：不仅仅是		more than 表达“不只是”的含义。
This fact was drawn to my attention dramatically when a blind woman in one of my investigations decided on her own initiative to draw a wheel as it was spinning.当我在一项调查中的一位盲人女性主动决定画一个正在旋转的轮子时，这一事实戏剧性地引起了我的注意。drawn to one's attention：引起某人的注意
dramatically：戏剧性地，显著地
investigations：调查，研究
on one's own initiative：主动地
spinning：旋转的		be drawn to one's attention 为 draw sth to one's attention 的被动语态；decide to do... on one's own initiative 表示“主动决定做…”；as it was spinning 为时间状语从句。
To show this motion, she traced a curve inside the circle (Fig. 1).为了表现这种运动，她在圆圈内画了一条曲线（图1）。motion：运动
traced：勾勒，描画
curve：曲线		To show this motion 为不定式短语作目的状语。
I was taken aback.我大吃一惊。taken aback：吃惊，惊讶be taken aback 为固定搭配，表示“感到吃惊”。
Lines of motion, such as the one she used, are a very recent invention in the history of illustration.像她所用的那种运动线条，在插图史上是一项很晚近的发明。lines of motion：运动线条
recent invention：近期的发明
illustration：插图，图示		such as the one she used 为插入语，举例说明；are a very recent invention 为主系表结构。
Indeed, as art scholar David Kunzle notes, Wilhelm Busch, a trend-setting nineteenth-century cartoonist, used virtually no motion lines in his popular figures until about 1877.事实上，正如艺术学者戴维·孔兹勒所指出的，19世纪引领潮流的漫画家威廉·布施，直到大约1877年才在他流行的画作中几乎没有使用运动线条。scholar：学者
trend-setting：引领潮流的
cartoonist：漫画家
virtually：几乎
motion lines：运动线条
figures：人物，人像		as ... notes 为非限制性定语从句；a trend-setting ... cartoonist 为 Wilhelm Busch 的同位语；used virtually no ... until ... 结构表示“直到…才几乎没有使用”，即此前几乎不用。
When I asked several other blind study subjects to draw a spinning wheel, one particularly clever rendition appeared repeatedly: several subjects showed the wheel's spokes as curved lines.当我请其他几位盲人研究对象画一个旋转的轮子时，一种特别巧妙的画法反复出现：好几位对象把轮辐画成了曲线。study subjects：研究对象
spinning wheel：旋转的轮子
rendition：表现，画法
repeatedly：反复地
spokes：轮辐
curved lines：曲线		When 引导时间状语从句；冒号后对 clever rendition 进行解释；showed ... as ... 表示“把…显示为…”。
When asked about these curves, they all described them as metaphorical ways of suggesting motion.当被问及这些曲线时，他们都将其描述为暗示运动的隐喻方式。curves：曲线
described ... as：把…描述为
metaphorical：隐喻的
suggesting：暗示，表明		When asked... 为过去分词短语作时间状语，相当于 When they were asked...；describe ... as ... 为固定搭配；metaphorical ways of suggesting motion 表示“用隐喻的方式暗示运动”。
